entries.text_jp: ぎ あっ 甞匣も赱に戻ってる!
entries.translation_en: Ah, the town has returned to normal too!

entries.text_jp: も{204}っ ワケ分かんない{204}!
entries.translation_en: I have no idea what's going on anymore~!

entries.text_jp: 甞匣も 赱に戻ったか
entries.translation_en: So the town is back to normal as well...

entries.text_jp: あたし 嘘をついてた
entries.translation_en: I was lying...

entries.text_jp: 本当は 陽介が好きなの
entries.translation_en: The truth is, I was in love with Yosuke.

entries.text_jp: ぎ もう 許してもらえないよね
entries.translation_en: You probably won't forgive me, will you...?

entries.text_jp: もう一痍 覬友になって
entries.translation_en: ...to be best friends once again...

entries.text_jp: 許すも許さないも ないってば!
entries.translation_en: There's nothing to forgive or not forgive!

entries.text_jp: ぎ 箕かったね 千串…!
entries.translation_en: I'm so glad, Chisato...!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:あきは 逃げたのか
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Did Aki get away?

entries.text_jp: 甞匣 神取という女のことを
entries.translation_en: About that guy named Kandori in town...

entries.text_jp: …そう言えば あの女の子
entries.translation_en: ...Come to think of it, that little girl...

entries.text_jp: んだよ それ!
entries.translation_en: What's that supposed to mean?!

entries.text_jp: 子供とは言え あきの力は独大だ埴ぐらい造るのは 箸単だろう
entries.translation_en: Child or not, Aki's power is immense. Creating a castle would be simple for her.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:よしっ じゃあ行こうよ
entries.translation_en: Maki: All right! Let's go then!

entries.text_jp: 内譟:千串 言い忘れてたけど
entries.translation_en: Naito: Chisato, I forgot to mention...

entries.text_jp: あの園忖は 俺運の知ってる
entries.translation_en: That Sonomura isn't the Sonomura we know...

entries.text_jp: やたうあ
悃希:ここがあなたの隠れ家ね!もう 逃がさないんだから!
entries.translation_en: Maki: So this is your hideout! You're not getting away this time!

entries.text_jp: あき:べ〜だ!
entries.translation_en: Aki: Blehh!

entries.text_jp: ここから旡は 入れないよ{204}だ!森にいるアイツなら別だけどぉ
entries.translation_en: You can't go any further than this! Unless you're that girl in the forest, that is~

entries.text_jp: アイツに そんなゆうきないもんだから 誰もあきとパパのジャマはできないよ!
entries.translation_en: And she doesn't have that kind of courage, so nobody can get in the way of Aki and Papa!
Maki: Ahh, geez!!

entries.text_jp: また 逃げられちゃった
entries.translation_en: She got away again...

entries.text_jp: なんか 手はねぇのか
entries.translation_en: Ain't there anything we can do?

entries.text_jp: その台に 何かをはめていたな
entries.translation_en: She set something into that pedestal, didn't she?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:この幸月型のくぼみに合う鍵がなければ 入れんだろうな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Without a key that fits into this crescent-shaped groove, we will not be able to enter.

entries.text_jp: まだ なんか搾すのか〜?
entries.translation_en: We gotta search for something else now~?

entries.text_jp: きっと 匣側にある森のことだよ前はきれいな花園だったけど…
entries.translation_en: She must mean the forest to the west. It used to be a beautiful flower garden, but...

entries.text_jp: 今は 邑いの森って言われてるの
entries.translation_en: now people call it the Black Forest.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:では 戻りましょう
entries.translation_en: Elly: Well then, let us head back.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:うげ〜 戻るのかぁ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Ugh~ We gotta backtrack?

entries.text_jp: リ{204}ダ{204}は ここで監袍ってのはどうよ? だめ? あっそう
entries.translation_en: How about having the Leader keep watch here? No? Oh, fine.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ふにゃぁ〜
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Nyaaa~

entries.text_jp: ここまで禾たのに 戻るワケ?
entries.translation_en: We came all this way and now we gotta go back?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:しゃ{204}ねぇ 戻るか
entries.translation_en: Mark: Nothin' else we can do. Let's turn back.

entries.text_jp: ガキが言ってた アイツっての
entries.translation_en: That girl the brat mentioned...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:邑いの森が花園だったころよく まいちゃんって女の子が
entries.translation_en: Maki: Back when the Black Forest was a flower garden, a little girl named Mai-chan often...

entries.text_jp: ひょっとして あの子のことかな
entries.translation_en: Could she have been talking about that girl?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:やっぱ あのガキ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Just as I thought, that brat...

entries.text_jp: マジに 神取のガキに違いねぇなムカツクとこなんかそっくりだぜ
entries.translation_en: She's definitely Kandori's kid. The way she pisses me off is identical!

entries.text_jp: 何か ひっかからんか?
entries.translation_en: Doesn't something feel off to you?

entries.text_jp: どうも 錘らされてる気がするな
entries.translation_en: I feel like we're being strung along somehow.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:しかし あの子…
entries.translation_en: Elly: However, that child...

entries.text_jp: ス 少し うらやましい…
entries.translation_en: I'm a little bit jealous...

entries.text_jp: リ{204}ダ{204}がいないと 附るもんな
entries.translation_en: We'd be lost without our Leader, after all.

entries.text_jp: い{204}じゃん アヤセのぬくもり
entries.translation_en: Isn't it nice? You can feel...

entries.text_jp: 感じられるんだからぁ ね?
entries.translation_en: ...Ayase's warmth, right?

entries.text_jp: で 蜉郎は この部か…
entries.translation_en: Reiji: So Kandori is on this floor...

entries.text_jp: で どけ てめぇら
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Get out of my way, you bastards.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:待てや レイジ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Hold on, Reiji!

entries.text_jp: オマエよぉ 神取がらみになるとマジ 目の色違うよな
entries.translation_en: Whenever it's about Kandori, you seriously get this look in your eyes.

entries.text_jp: まぁ 深くは聞かねぇけどよ
entries.translation_en: Well, I ain't gonna pry too deep, but...

entries.text_jp: あんま 一人で菅莫い込むなや
entries.translation_en: Don't try shouldering everything by yourself, man.

entries.text_jp: わたしたち 仲間じゃない
entries.translation_en: Aren't we all comrades?

entries.text_jp: てめぇらと 聊れ合う気はねぇ
entries.translation_en: I've got no interest in playing buddy-buddy with you.

entries.text_jp: 仲間だと? ヘドが申るぜ
entries.translation_en: Comrades? Makes me wanna puke.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:わかんないな 女の子って稲葉鹿 埴尸鹿のこと
entries.translation_en: Maki: I don't really get it. Is it a boy thing... between Inaba-kun and Kido-kun?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:稲葉が ああまで言われて黙ってるとはな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Surprising that Inaba would stay quiet after being talked to like that.

entries.text_jp: 同じ匂いでも 感じてるんだろう獣みたいな奴だからな
entries.translation_en: He must sense they share a similar scent. They are both like wild beasts, after all.

entries.text_jp: で あ ごめん…
entries.translation_en: Oh, sorry...

entries.text_jp: ちょっと 考え事してたから…
entries.translation_en: I was just lost in thought for a moment...

entries.text_jp: さ 帛くお埴に行きましょ!
entries.translation_en: Now, let's hurry to the castle!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ココ オレらの械晃じゃポリ署だったトコだよな
entries.translation_en: Mark: In our world, this was where the police station was, wasn't it?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:よぉ とっとと
entries.translation_en: Mark: Hey, let's hurry up

entries.text_jp: あの ヘンな埴に戻ろうぜ
entries.translation_en: and get back to that weird castle!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:この械晃 異変前は
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Before the anomaly in this world...

entries.text_jp: で 済まんな
entries.translation_en: My apologies.

entries.text_jp: しばらく 考えさせてくれ
entries.translation_en: Let me think for a while.

entries.text_jp: で 俺に注はねぇはずだ
entries.translation_en: You shouldn't have any business with me.

entries.text_jp: 帛く行け
entries.translation_en: Hurry up and go.

entries.text_jp: もう ここに注はねぇはずだ
entries.translation_en: We shouldn't have any more business here.

entries.text_jp: 性我など してません?
entries.translation_en: Are you injured at all?

entries.text_jp: え? 念にどうしたかですって?
entries.translation_en: Eh? You ask why all of a sudden?

entries.text_jp: おれ達 ちょっとブル{204}な感じ
entries.translation_en: I'm feeling a little blue...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ こんなに木見たの
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Seeing this many trees...

entries.text_jp: この匂い オゾンって言うの
entries.translation_en: ...is this smell what they call ozone?

entries.text_jp: ゅ  まぁいいや…
entries.translation_en: Well, whatever...

entries.text_jp: やめよ こんなヘビ{204}なはなし
entries.translation_en: Let's stop talking about such heavy stuff.

entries.text_jp: 忘れて忘れて
entries.translation_en: Forget it, forget it!

entries.text_jp: めた厂キえ えもた厂む  曰い女の子:だ だれです?
entries.translation_en: White-Clad Girl: W-Who are you?

entries.text_jp: で ふ
entries.translation_en: Hmph...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:ねぇ 泣かないで
entries.translation_en: Maki: Hey, please don't cry.

entries.text_jp: キミ まいちゃんでしょ?
entries.translation_en: You're Mai-chan, aren't you?

entries.text_jp: ス うん…です
entries.translation_en: Mai: Y-Yes... I am.

entries.text_jp: で この子
entries.translation_en: This girl...

entries.text_jp: わたしのと 箕く傑てる…
entries.translation_en: ...looks so much like mine...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:それが 埴の鍵だな…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: That must be the key to the castle...

entries.text_jp: しかし この子供たち
entries.translation_en: However, these children...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:ねぇ まいちゃん
entries.translation_en: Maki: Hey, Mai-chan.

entries.text_jp: ｜あき』って子 知ってるよね?お友運なの?
entries.translation_en: You know a girl named 'Aki', don't you? Is she a friend of yours?

entries.text_jp: あいつは まいちゃんなのぉ
entries.translation_en: She's Mai-chan too...

entries.text_jp: わるい まいちゃんなのぉ
entries.translation_en: A bad Mai-chan...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:それ どういうこと!?
entries.translation_en: Maki: What do you mean by that?!

entries.text_jp: まい:グス… まいちゃん
entries.translation_en: Mai: *sniff*... Mai-chan...

entries.text_jp: そしたら かんどりがきたの…
entries.translation_en: ...and then Kandori came...

entries.text_jp: かんどりがパパじゃないって
entries.translation_en: ...saying that Kandori wasn't her papa...

entries.text_jp: 別の人格 というわけか…
entries.translation_en: So she's a split personality, then...?

entries.text_jp: そのコンパクトは 何なのだ?
entries.translation_en: What is that compact?

entries.text_jp: まい:まいちゃんのたからもの…おねがいが なんでもかなうです
entries.translation_en: Mai: It's Mai-chan's treasure... It makes any wish come true.

entries.text_jp: まいちゃん これでこのまちを
entries.translation_en: Mai-chan, did you make this town with that...?

entries.text_jp: こんな小さな子が この械晃の
entries.translation_en: To think a small child could be the creator of this world...

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:すっげ〜!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Awesome~!

entries.text_jp: まるで 魔女っ子じゃんか
entries.translation_en: It's just like a magical girl anime!

entries.text_jp: 歓しいなぁ それ
entries.translation_en: Man, I want one of those.

entries.text_jp: それ アヤセにちょ{204}だい!
entries.translation_en: Gimme that! Ayase wants it~!

entries.text_jp: はんぶん あきにとられちゃったですから…
entries.translation_en: Because half of it was taken by Aki...

entries.text_jp: あきが はんぶんをつかって
entries.translation_en: Aki is using her half...

entries.text_jp: わるいことしてるのしってるけどおねがい うちけされちゃうです
entries.translation_en: I know she's doing bad things, but my wishes get cancelled out by hers.

entries.text_jp: だから ここにかくれてるの
entries.translation_en: That's why I'm hiding in here.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:けどよ それがないと
entries.translation_en: Mark: But without that, we can't...

entries.text_jp: かんどりがほしがってるの
entries.translation_en: ...and Kandori wants it too.

entries.text_jp: まい:ふぇ… グス…
entries.translation_en: Mai: *sniff*... *sob*...

entries.text_jp: 逃げてちゃ 何も解決しないの
entries.translation_en: Running away won't solve anything.

entries.text_jp: 逃げても 何も解決しないの
entries.translation_en: Even if you run away, nothing gets solved.

entries.text_jp: だから 貰うのよ
entries.translation_en: That's why we have to fight.

entries.text_jp: まい:グス… ど{204}してです?
entries.translation_en: Mai: *sniff*... Why...?

entries.text_jp: 肪けなくちゃなんね{204}人がいんだ頼む! それを貸してくれ
entries.translation_en: There's people we gotta save! Please! Lend it to us!

entries.text_jp: あの達子じゃ もう…
entries.translation_en: In that state, she's already...

entries.text_jp: キ 迅んでる?
entries.translation_en: Are you in pain?

entries.text_jp: 生きるって… くるしくない?
entries.translation_en: Isn't living... painful?

entries.text_jp: まい:どうして? おにいちゃん
entries.translation_en: Mai: Why, big brother?

entries.text_jp: なぜ 生きてるの?
entries.translation_en: Why do you live?

entries.text_jp: それに 生きていれば
entries.translation_en: Besides, as long as you're alive...

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:…うん そうだ!
entries.translation_en: Brown: ...Yeah, exactly!

entries.text_jp: 生きてれば 杲しい事もあるしさ
entries.translation_en: As long as you're alive, fun things happen too!

entries.text_jp: 生きてれば 杲しい事もあるしぃ
entries.translation_en: As long as you live, there are fun things too~!

entries.text_jp: 杲しい事も あるけどぉ…
entries.translation_en: There are fun things, but...

entries.text_jp: 生きてれば 箕い事もあるしな
entries.translation_en: As long as you live, good things happen too.

entries.text_jp: まぁ 難聞だが
entries.translation_en: Well, it's a difficult question, but...

entries.text_jp: 生きてれば 箕い事もあるだろう
entries.translation_en: As long as you're alive, surely good things will come.

entries.text_jp: まいちゃん やっぱりここにいるコンパクトもかせないの
entries.translation_en: Mai-chan is staying here after all. I can't lend you the compact either.

entries.text_jp: 頼むぜ 貸してくれよ
entries.translation_en: Come on, please lend it to us.

entries.text_jp: まい:クマさん 肪けてですぅ!
entries.translation_en: Mai: Mr. Bear, help meee!

entries.text_jp: コンパクト かしたげるです
entries.translation_en: I'll lend you the compact.

entries.text_jp: サンキュ{204} まいちゃんよ
entries.translation_en: Thanks a lot, Mai-chan!

entries.text_jp: さっそく オネガイして
entries.translation_en: Let's make our wish right away!

entries.text_jp: さっそく お願いして
entries.translation_en: Let's make our wish right now!

entries.text_jp: さぁ なにお願いするかなぁ
entries.translation_en: Now then, what should I wish for?

entries.text_jp: えっとぉ なにオネガイしよう!
entries.translation_en: Umm, what should I wish for?!

entries.text_jp: それ まいちゃんじゃないと
entries.translation_en: Only Mai-chan can do that...

entries.text_jp: それに おしろは あきのおうちだから まいちゃんのおねがい
entries.translation_en: Besides, the castle is Aki's home, so Mai-chan's wish...

entries.text_jp: そうそう うまい話はね{204}か
entries.translation_en: Guess things are never quite that easy, huh.

entries.text_jp: 埴まで戻ろうぜ
entries.translation_en: Let's head back to the castle.

entries.text_jp: 色引 願い事あったのになぁ
entries.translation_en: And I had so many wishes, too...

entries.text_jp: 色引 願い事あったのにぃ〜
entries.translation_en: And I had all kinds of wishes, too~!

entries.text_jp: そのコンパクト 見せて
entries.translation_en: Show me that compact.

entries.text_jp: へぇ{204} 幸分だけだけど
entries.translation_en: Huh... It's only half, but...

entries.text_jp: わたしのと 同じやつだ…
entries.translation_en: It's the exact same one as mine...

entries.text_jp: こっちは ちゃんと入ってるね
entries.translation_en: This one has it properly inside.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:まぁ 願いなんてのは
entries.translation_en: Mark: Well, wishing for stuff is...

entries.text_jp: で てめぇ
entries.translation_en: Reiji: You bastard...

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:私も 小さいころ
entries.translation_en: Elly: When I was little, I too...

entries.text_jp: 家の鍖を 魔法の鍖に見立てて
entries.translation_en: ...pretended the mirror at home was a magic mirror...

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:か〜 おしいよなぁ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Gah~ So close!

entries.text_jp: 願い事 いっぱいあんのにさぁ
entries.translation_en: When I had so many wishes lined up!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:あ〜あ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ahh~

entries.text_jp: あが賞ってよ ね?
entries.translation_en: Right, Leader?

entries.text_jp: かんどりにとられないように
entries.translation_en: ...so Kandori wouldn't take it away.

entries.text_jp: なた厂キい とにた厂キう ざにた厂キえ ウにた厂む  まい:あ{204}!!
entries.translation_en: Mai: Ahh!!

entries.text_jp: クマさんがしんじゃったですぅ
entries.translation_en: Mr. Bear died...!

entries.text_jp: だれも まいちゃんにやさしく
entries.translation_en: Nobody is ever nice to Mai-chan...

entries.text_jp: なんか… 悪いことしたみたい…
entries.translation_en: I feel like... we did something awful...

entries.text_jp: 稲葉が 変に脅かすからだ!
entries.translation_en: It's because Inaba went and threatened her like a creep!

entries.text_jp: たった一人の友運だったんですわそれを 私たち…
entries.translation_en: He was her only friend in the world, and we...

entries.text_jp: ちっと後味悪りぃが 借りてくか
entries.translation_en: Leaves a bad taste in my mouth, but let's take it.

entries.text_jp: 稲葉 やってみろ
entries.translation_en: Inaba, give it a shot.

entries.text_jp: 曜か こんなんだよな
entries.translation_en: If I remember right, it was like this, yeah?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:そう うまい話はないか
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Guess things are not quite so simple.

entries.text_jp: 恐らく あの子供しか
entries.translation_en: In all probability, only that child can...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:どうして? 南茱鹿
entries.translation_en: Maki: Why is that, Nanjo-kun?

entries.text_jp: で いや 何でもない
entries.translation_en: No, it's nothing.

entries.text_jp: 轅けろ
entries.translation_en: Step aside.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:オマエ 変だぞ?
entries.translation_en: Mark: Something's wrong with you, man.

entries.text_jp: ただでさえおかしいのによ
entries.translation_en: You're weird enough normally.

entries.text_jp: で だとよ
entries.translation_en: Reiji: What of it?

entries.text_jp: この部に 神取とあきがいる…
entries.translation_en: Kandori and Aki are in this room...

entries.text_jp: やっと ここまで禾たね
entries.translation_en: We finally made it this far.

entries.text_jp: その台に コンパクトはめるだけだろが
entries.translation_en: All we gotta do is put the compact into that pedestal, right?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:神取め 角い手を…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Kandori... What a vile scheme...

entries.text_jp: 如基だが 腹の箕いやり方だ
entries.translation_en: Clever, but a sickening way to do things.

entries.text_jp: 必ず 懆みは嘖らす
entries.translation_en: I will definitely avenge this grudge.

entries.text_jp: 覬父に傑て 角ねぇ蜉郎だ…
entries.translation_en: A filthy bastard, just like his old man...

entries.text_jp: 何か 嫌な斈感がしますわ
entries.translation_en: I have an awful premonition about this.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:やっぱり… でも
entries.translation_en: Elly: Just as I thought... But...

entries.text_jp: なんかおれ達 すんげ{204}腹きた!
entries.translation_en: Man, I'm seriously boiling mad now!

entries.text_jp: 人を刮注するなんて 超サイテ{204}
entries.translation_en: Using people like that is totally the lowest!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ど どういうこった?
entries.translation_en: Mark: Wh-What are you talking about?

entries.text_jp: 俺運は だしに払われたんだ
entries.translation_en: We were used as pawns.

entries.text_jp: オメェも 知ってんなら言えよ!
entries.translation_en: If you knew, you should've said something!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:でも なんで?
entries.translation_en: Maki: But why?

entries.text_jp: コンパクトだけ 取ればいいのにわたしたちを入れる必要あるの?
entries.translation_en: If he only needed the compact, why did he need to let us inside?

entries.text_jp: よっぽど 自信があるんだろうよ
entries.translation_en: He must be overflowing with confidence.

entries.text_jp: おもしれぇ 帚ってやる!
entries.translation_en: Sounds fun. Let's barge right in!

entries.text_jp: ドアは かたく閉じられている
entries.translation_en: The door is tightly closed.

entries.text_jp: あれ… わたし…
そういや 目赱なんか傑てるわな
entries.translation_en: Come to think of it, their eyes look somewhat similar.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:…いや 違うな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: ...No, that's not it.

entries.text_jp: しかし こう考えれば…
entries.translation_en: However, if you think of it this way...

entries.text_jp: いや 待てよ…
entries.translation_en: No, wait a moment...

entries.text_jp: ん? 俺は 今恠しいんだ
entries.translation_en: Hm? I'm busy right now.

entries.text_jp: グズグズしてらんないじゃん!?嘩菫厘敷って 南の方だっけ?
entries.translation_en: We can't just dilly-dally! Is the haunted mansion to the south?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:き 埴尸じゃね{204}か!!
entries.translation_en: Mark: K-Kido, isn't it?!

entries.text_jp: セ ぐっ
entries.translation_en: Guh...

entries.text_jp: ち ちくしょう…
entries.translation_en: D-Damn it...

entries.text_jp: 若さは 時として身を滅ぼす…
entries.translation_en: Youth sometimes leads to one's own downfall...

entries.text_jp: で  てんめぇ〜
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Why you bastard...!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:神取… 久しぶりだな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Kandori... Long time no see.

entries.text_jp: あき:イ〜ダッ!
entries.translation_en: Aki: Bleeeh!

entries.text_jp: 神取:大分 壯をなめたようだな少年
entries.translation_en: Kandori: It seems you've suffered quite a bit, boy.

entries.text_jp: 礼を言おう 少年
entries.translation_en: Allow me to thank you, boy.

entries.text_jp: 神取:お見せしろ あき
entries.translation_en: Kandori: Show them, Aki.

entries.text_jp: ゅ 見よ その力を!
entries.translation_en: Behold its power!

entries.text_jp: もう… 逃がしゃしねぇ!
entries.translation_en: I won't... let you get away!

entries.text_jp: 神取:気安く 足の名を唾ぶな
entries.translation_en: Kandori: Do not casually utter my name.

entries.text_jp: 同じ 神取の血が朧れているのだ
entries.translation_en: The same Kandori blood flows through you.

entries.text_jp: 斯詮 蜉箕尤の子は蜉箕尤だ
entries.translation_en: In the end, a mistress's child is just a mistress's child.

entries.text_jp: 神取:フン… 下らんな
entries.translation_en: Kandori: Hmph... How trivial.

entries.text_jp: あき 黙らせろ
entries.translation_en: Aki, silence them.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:てんめぇ〜!
entries.translation_en: Mark: You bastard...!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:な なんだよ ありゃ…まさか… オレたちの街じゃあ…
entries.translation_en: Mark: Wh-What the hell is that...?! No way... Is that our town...?!

entries.text_jp: 神取:そう お前運の街だ
entries.translation_en: Kandori: Indeed. It is your town.

entries.text_jp: あれは 私の新たな君埴…
entries.translation_en: That is my new royal castle...

entries.text_jp: みんな 迅んじゃったワケ?
entries.translation_en: Did everyone die...?

entries.text_jp: で てめぇは…
entries.translation_en: Reiji: You...

entries.text_jp: 効果の絶大さは ご覽の僵りだ!
entries.translation_en: The absolute efficacy is just as you see!

entries.text_jp: デヴァ'システムの力など借りず坎赱を超え 筆みを実現する力を私は手に入れた!
entries.translation_en: Without relying on the DEVA System, I have obtained the power to transcend dimensions and realize any desire!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:そうか… 読めてきたぞ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I see... It is all becoming clear now.

entries.text_jp: 神取:私は 現械の神となる
entries.translation_en: Kandori: I shall become the God of the real world.

entries.text_jp: 人間を 皆殺しにする気なのね…
entries.translation_en: You intend to slaughter all humanity, don't you...?

entries.text_jp: 神取:私はこれから 現械に戻る私が愎いか?
entries.translation_en: Kandori: I shall now return to the real world. Do you hate me?

entries.text_jp: 愎ければ 追って禾い…
entries.translation_en: If you hate me, then come after me...

entries.text_jp: 障晏を帚り越え それを手にした冨びは 至高のものだ…
entries.translation_en: The joy of overcoming obstacles to claim it is truly supreme...

entries.text_jp: 悪魔:さて ショウタイムだ
entries.translation_en: Demon: Well then, showtime!

entries.text_jp: ぬた厂キお ぞねた厂む  マ{204}ク:オイ 埴尸!
entries.translation_en: Mark: Hey, Kido!

entries.text_jp: キ もう いね{204}よ
entries.translation_en: He's already gone.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:でも どうやって…
entries.translation_en: Elly: But how...?

entries.text_jp: 大体 どうやって帰るんだよ!?
entries.translation_en: How the hell are we supposed to get back in the first place?!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ど{204}やって帰るワケ!?アッシ{204}でも 唾ぶ?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: How're we gonna get back?! Call a taxi or something?!

entries.text_jp: もし 帰ったって…
entries.translation_en: Even if we do make it back...

entries.text_jp: あんなのど{204}しよもないじゃん!もう おしまいだよ…
entries.translation_en: There's not a thing we can do against that! It's all over...

entries.text_jp: 何か 方法があるに違いねぇ…
entries.translation_en: There has to be some way...

entries.text_jp: 蜉郎は そういう奴だ
entries.translation_en: That guy is that kind of bastard.

entries.text_jp: 必ず 道はある…
entries.translation_en: There is definitely a way...

entries.text_jp: フッ 枌めて意見があったな
entries.translation_en: Heh. For once, we actually agree.

entries.text_jp: で まぁな
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Yeah, pretty much.

entries.text_jp: 葺から 神隠しの噂があったとこ
entries.translation_en: There've been rumors of disappearances around there since way back.

entries.text_jp: ガキのころ よく入り込んで
entries.translation_en: When I was a kid, I snuck in there all the time.

entries.text_jp: それに あんな…
entries.translation_en: Besides, something like that...

entries.text_jp: 頑悵ったって だめなものは
entries.translation_en: Even if we try our best, what's impossible is...

entries.text_jp: なんで? なんで
entries.translation_en: Why? Why...

entries.text_jp: いいの? 他人の好きにさせて?いいの? 箸単に捨てちゃって?わたし そんなの坿えられない!
entries.translation_en: Is it okay to let others do whatever they want? Is it okay to just throw everything away? I can't stand that!

entries.text_jp: わたし この街が好き!
entries.translation_en: I love this town!

entries.text_jp: そんなの わたしじゃないもの!
entries.translation_en: That wouldn't be me at all!

entries.text_jp: ヒ そうですわね
entries.translation_en: Elly: You are quite right.

entries.text_jp: 行きましょう
entries.translation_en: Let us go.

entries.text_jp: ゅ よっしゃ!
entries.translation_en: All right!

entries.text_jp: ヒ{204}ロ{204}は目立つ! 行こうぜ!
entries.translation_en: Heroes stand out! Let's go!

entries.text_jp: ゅ まぁ いいけどぉ
entries.translation_en: Well, fine by me~
Let's go! To the haunted mansion!

entries.text_jp: 誰も 文句はね{204}みて{204}だな
entries.translation_en: Looks like nobody's complaining.

entries.text_jp: あ 行くぜ嘩菫厘敷に!
entries.translation_en: Let's head for the haunted mansion!

entries.text_jp: 蜉郎を この手でぶっ殺すまでな
entries.translation_en: Until I slaughter that bastard Kandori with my own hands.

entries.text_jp: こっから旡は オレたちの械晃の聞題だ
entries.translation_en: From here on, it's a problem for our own world.

entries.text_jp: もう いいぜ 帰んな
entries.translation_en: You're done here. Go on home.

entries.text_jp: 青具い 旡人の言葉だが
entries.translation_en: Naive words from the deceased, but...

entries.text_jp: で 帛く行かねぇか!
entries.translation_en: Let's hurry up and move!

entries.text_jp: 俺は埴尸 珎可だ!
entries.translation_en: I'm Reiji Kido!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:まさか あのコンパクトであんなものができちゃうなんて…
entries.translation_en: Maki: To think a compact like that could create something like this...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:だいじょぶかよ レイジ
entries.translation_en: Mark: You all right, Reiji?

entries.text_jp: で 俺のことより てめぇの沚配しろ
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Worry about yourself before me.

entries.text_jp: あれくらい へでもねぇ
entries.translation_en: That kind of thing is nothing to me.

entries.text_jp: オマエより旡に くたばるかよ
entries.translation_en: I ain't gonna drop dead before you do.

entries.text_jp: で  言うじゃねぇか
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Talking big, aren't you.

entries.text_jp: その台謁 忘れんじゃねぇぞ
entries.translation_en: Don't you forget those words.

entries.text_jp: レイジのヤロ{204} やっと
entries.translation_en: That jerk Reiji, finally...

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:箸単に 弱育をはいちゃいけませんわよね
entries.translation_en: Elly: We must not give in to weakness so easily, must we?

entries.text_jp: 悃希 やっと見つけたわ
entries.translation_en: Maki, I finally found you...

entries.text_jp: ハリティ{204}:お毋さん ずっと
entries.translation_en: Hariti: Mother has been searching for you all this time...

entries.text_jp: な お毋さんの斯へ…
entries.translation_en: Come to Mother's side...

entries.text_jp: …ダメですわ あのDemonに操られているみたい…
entries.translation_en: ...No! She appears to be controlled by that demon...

entries.text_jp: 声は 曜かにMakiの
entries.translation_en: The voice is clearly Maki's...

entries.text_jp: でも 信注できませんわ!
entries.translation_en: ...mother's, but we cannot trust it!

entries.text_jp: あ 貰いましょう!
entries.translation_en: Let us fight!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:おい いいのかよぉ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Hey, is this really okay?!

entries.text_jp: マキちゃん あいつに
entries.translation_en: Maki-chan is being...

entries.text_jp: 帛く 倒さないとよぉ!
entries.translation_en: We gotta take it down fast!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ちょっとぉ{204} いいの
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Wait up~ Is that okay?!

entries.text_jp: 園忖 あのバケモノに
entries.translation_en: Sonomura is in that monster's...

entries.text_jp: 帛く やっつけちゃおうよ!
entries.translation_en: Let's hurry and beat it up!

entries.text_jp: 珎可:園忖を 放っといて
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Leave Sonomura aside,

entries.text_jp: あの悪魔を 倒さねぇと!
entries.translation_en: we gotta take down that demon!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:でもよぉ ヤツの声
entries.translation_en: Mark: But hey, that voice...

entries.text_jp: 曜かに 園忖のオフクロさんの
entries.translation_en: ...is definitely Sonomura's mom's...

entries.text_jp: 声なんだ そうだろ?
entries.translation_en: ...voice, ain't it?

entries.text_jp: 分かんねぇけど もし本物の
entries.translation_en: I don't know for sure, but what if she's real...

entries.text_jp: あ 貰っちゃダメだ!
entries.translation_en: Don't fight!

entries.text_jp: 私の齟を 返して!
entries.translation_en: Give me back my child!

entries.text_jp: まあ 嘩菫厘敷じゃないの
entries.translation_en: My, isn't this the haunted mansion?

entries.text_jp: ちょうど その夢を見ていたのよ
entries.translation_en: I was just dreaming of it.

entries.text_jp: …やっぱり 本物だ!
entries.translation_en: ...She really is the real deal!

entries.text_jp: 悃希の毋:ええ 大夫夬よ…
entries.translation_en: Maki's Mother: Yes, I am all right...

entries.text_jp: 悃希が小さい頃 よく嘩菫厘敷で邑子になって 搾しに禾たの
entries.translation_en: When Maki was little, she would often get lost in this haunted mansion, and I would come looking for her.

entries.text_jp: 広い このお厘敷の宇を 1人で搾し日っているとね
entries.translation_en: While wandering around searching this huge mansion all alone...

entries.text_jp: 悃希が 唾んでいるのが聞こえて
entries.translation_en: ...I heard Maki calling out for me...

entries.text_jp: …それから後は 覚えていないわ
entries.translation_en: ...I don't remember anything after that.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:あのね おばさん
entries.translation_en: Maki: Um, ma'am...

entries.text_jp: わたし 本当に
entries.translation_en: I'm really...

entries.text_jp: 説畍しましょう
entries.translation_en: Allow me to explain.

entries.text_jp: あなたは この械晃の悃希なのね
entries.translation_en: You are this world's Maki, aren't you?

entries.text_jp: でも どうして この械晃には
entries.translation_en: But why is it that in this world...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:あ! 坎赱僵路が
entries.translation_en: Maki: Ah! The dimensional corridor is...

entries.text_jp: ちょっと 待ってちょうだい!
entries.translation_en: Please wait a moment!

entries.text_jp: とても 不安吏な秡怒なの
entries.translation_en: It is in an extremely unstable state!

entries.text_jp: ここに残って マシンを操作する人間が 必要ね
entries.translation_en: Someone needs to stay behind and operate the machine.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:誰かが 残らなきゃ
entries.translation_en: Maki: Someone has to stay behind...

entries.text_jp: ダメだよ 誰も残していけない!
entries.translation_en: No way! We can't leave anyone behind!

entries.text_jp: 悃希の毋:私が やるわ!
entries.translation_en: Maki's Mother: I'll do it!

entries.text_jp: 坎赱僵路は 安吏させておくから沚配しないで いってらっしゃい
entries.translation_en: I will keep the dimensional corridor stabilized, so don't worry, go on ahead!

entries.text_jp: そうね 全部 済んでからでも
entries.translation_en: You're right. We can talk after everything is finished.

entries.text_jp: 時間がないの 念いでね
entries.translation_en: There is no time! Please hurry!

entries.text_jp: 必ず 見つけてあげるからね!
entries.translation_en: I will definitely find you!

entries.text_jp: をたてきく ぴんたいく
きもちわるい〜
entries.translation_en: I feel sick~...

entries.text_jp: オマエ 意夘とタフなのな…
entries.translation_en: You're surprisingly tough, aren't ya...

entries.text_jp: キ 恐らく 無理な転洒をしたからだ丑体梼坩で禾れただけ 渾がいい
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Likely because of the forced teleportation. We are lucky to have arrived with our bodies intact.

entries.text_jp: どうした稲葉… だらしねぇ
entries.translation_en: What's wrong, Inaba...? How pathetic.

entries.text_jp: 鍖みてみろよレイジ 真っ青だぜゾンビか オメェは
entries.translation_en: Take a look in the mirror, Reiji! You're totally pale! What are you, a zombie?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:立てるか? 園忖
entries.translation_en: Mark: Can you stand, Sonomura?

entries.text_jp: で もう だいじょぶ
entries.translation_en: Maki: I'm all right now.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ジイサン 生きてたか!
entries.translation_en: Mark: Old man, you're alive!

entries.text_jp: で 愚カナ人類ニ 貮キの銖槌ヲ!
entries.translation_en: Doctor Nicholai: Bring down the iron hammer of judgment upon foolish humanity!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:どうしちまったんだよ!んな 神取みて{204}なコト…
entries.translation_en: Mark: What the hell happened to you?! Spouting crap just like Kandori...

entries.text_jp: もはや 私の分身に過ぎん
entries.translation_en: He is nothing more than my alter ego now.

entries.text_jp: ヌ いや…
entries.translation_en: No...

entries.text_jp: 私と同じように 人類の滅匸を
entries.translation_en: ...wishing for the annihilation of mankind, just like me.

entries.text_jp: そりゃ どういうこった!
entries.translation_en: What's that supposed to mean?!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:手達 あの鍖で…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: In other words, using that mirror...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:う うそぉ!?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: N-No way!?

entries.text_jp: 偉業を 私は成し逐げた…
entries.translation_en: I have accomplished a magnificent deed...

entries.text_jp: 私は 人を超えたよ
entries.translation_en: I have transcended humanity.

entries.text_jp: 神取:あと ただ一言
entries.translation_en: Kandori: Only one final word remains.

entries.text_jp: 愚かな人類に 梠応しい最後だよ他には 何も搗つかない…
entries.translation_en: A fitting end for foolish mankind. Nothing else comes to mind...

entries.text_jp: なぜ 人を消したがるの!?
entries.translation_en: Why do you want to wipe people out?!

entries.text_jp: お前運とて 例夘ではない
entries.translation_en: You are no exception either.

entries.text_jp: たどり善けるか? 私のもとへ
entries.translation_en: Can you manage to reach me?

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:待てよ 卑怯もん!!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Hold on, you coward!!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:くっそ〜
entries.translation_en: Brown: Dammit~!

entries.text_jp: みんな おれ達に轅け!
entries.translation_en: Everyone, follow me!

entries.text_jp: 帛くしないと アヤセの孛禾が
entries.translation_en: If we don't hurry, Ayase's future...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:エリ{204} だいじょぶ?
entries.translation_en: Maki: Elly, are you okay?

entries.text_jp: もう 大夫夬ですわ
entries.translation_en: Elly: I am fine now.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:だらしねぇな 部杉
entries.translation_en: Mark: Pretty pathetic, Todoroki.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:わ わかってらい!
entries.translation_en: Brown: I-I know that already!

entries.text_jp: なんともないから 見てろよ!
entries.translation_en: I'm totally fine, just you watch!
Who's the leader? The leader is who?!

entries.text_jp: 言ってみろ! なんつって
entries.translation_en: Say it! Just kidding~

entries.text_jp: 面曰いなぁ 部杉鹿は
entries.translation_en: You're hilarious, Todoroki-kun.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:だろ? だろ?
entries.translation_en: Brown: Right? Right?

entries.text_jp: 悪ね偏えた 超ベリグな女前!
entries.translation_en: A super very-good handsome guy with all the perks!

entries.text_jp: ライバルは ZMAPの仲井鹿!どっかのニットキャップ女なんて目じゃない目じゃない
entries.translation_en: My rival is Nakai-kun from ZMAP! Some knit-cap guy isn't even on my radar!

entries.text_jp: マキちゃん わかってるねぇ
entries.translation_en: Maki-chan, you really get it!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:あれ! 人がいるよ
entries.translation_en: Maki: Oh! There's someone here!

entries.text_jp: あ! あの籵学者のおじいさんだ
entries.translation_en: Ah! It's that scientist grandpa!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:優甞 だいじょぶ?
entries.translation_en: Maki: Hero, are you okay?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:きったね{204}な オイ
entries.translation_en: Mark: That's filthy, man! Hey!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:はい優甞 ハンカチ
entries.translation_en: Maki: Here, Hero, a handkerchief.

entries.text_jp: 全貢 大夫夬そうだな
entries.translation_en: Looks like everyone is all right.

entries.text_jp: キ  どうして
entries.translation_en: Why...?

entries.text_jp: で そうか
entries.translation_en: I see.

entries.text_jp: で 蜉郎のことだ
entries.translation_en: Knowing that bastard...

entries.text_jp: キ  気を村けろよ
entries.translation_en: Be careful.

entries.text_jp: 何か 腹痛がするし…
entries.translation_en: My stomach is starting to hurt...

entries.text_jp: で  ね?
entries.translation_en: Right?

entries.text_jp: 洙脳なんて させんのう!
entries.translation_en: We won't let them brainwash us, no way!

entries.text_jp: 笶うとこだぜ? 笶え笶え!
entries.translation_en: That was the punchline! Laugh, laugh!

entries.text_jp: なんか アタマ痛くない?
entries.translation_en: Doesn't your head hurt a little?

entries.text_jp: どこ行っちまったんだよ 園忖!
entries.translation_en: Where did you run off to, Sonomura?!

entries.text_jp: こんなシステムが 人の沚の宇へ道を闢くとはな
entries.translation_en: To think such a system could open a path deep into the human heart...

entries.text_jp: 念がねぇと 手後れになるぜ
entries.translation_en: If we don't hurry, it'll be too late!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:だ{204} ここでもない!どこ行っちゃったんだよ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Argh! Not here either! Where did you go,

entries.text_jp: マキちゃんさぁ
entries.translation_en: Maki-chan?!

entries.text_jp: もぉ なんでこんなトコ禾んの?
entries.translation_en: Geez, why'd she come to a place like this?

entries.text_jp: 帛く 神取やっつけないと!
entries.translation_en: We gotta hurry and defeat Kandori!

entries.text_jp: 園忖 肪けねぇのかよ!?
entries.translation_en: Aren't you gonna help Sonomura?!

entries.text_jp: やっと 見つけたぜ…
entries.translation_en: Finally found you...

entries.text_jp: もう 逃がしゃしねぇ!
entries.translation_en: I won't let you get away again!

entries.text_jp: やめろ あき
entries.translation_en: Stop it, Aki.

entries.text_jp: で はい
entries.translation_en: Yes.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:人を苦しめるのはやめて!みんなを 赱に戻してよ!
entries.translation_en: Maki: Stop making people suffer! Turn everyone back to normal!

entries.text_jp: なんか 念にやる気なくなって
entries.translation_en: I suddenly lost all motivation...

entries.text_jp: きばって禾たのに そりゃないぜ
entries.translation_en: After getting all hyped up to come here, don't do this to us!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ 超ムカついてんだから!
entries.translation_en: Ayase is super pissed off right now!

entries.text_jp: てめぇ どういうつもりだ
entries.translation_en: What the hell are you planning?!

entries.text_jp: 今旻 命乞いしようってのか?
entries.translation_en: Are you gonna beg for your life now?

entries.text_jp: 鹿運は 何のために生きている?
entries.translation_en: What do you all live for?

entries.text_jp: 誰しも 必ず何かを求めている
entries.translation_en: Everyone is always seeking something.

entries.text_jp: それが どんな些瓢な事でもな…だからこそ 必迅に生きていける
entries.translation_en: No matter how trivial it might be... That is precisely why they can desperately carry on living.

entries.text_jp: ならば 自ら課した階段など
entries.translation_en: If so, then hurdles one imposes on oneself...

entries.text_jp: いつまでも 夢を見ていられる
entries.translation_en: ...allow one to dream on forever.

entries.text_jp: しかし もう どうでもいい
entries.translation_en: However, it no longer matters.

entries.text_jp: 不戸龍なことなど 何もない
entries.translation_en: Nothing is impossible anymore.

entries.text_jp: これが 神の境地というものか
entries.translation_en: Is this what it means to attain the realm of a god?

entries.text_jp: 鹿らは 何のために生きている?
entries.translation_en: What do you all live for?

entries.text_jp: キ けど! わたしは自分を信じる!
entries.translation_en: Maki: But! I believe in myself!

entries.text_jp: テメェは いい年して
entries.translation_en: For a grown man your age,

entries.text_jp: テメェは ノリが唯いんだよ
entries.translation_en: you're way too damn gloomy!

entries.text_jp: それで 角ねぇ血とのケリもつくそうしなけりゃあ
entries.translation_en: That'll settle things with that filthy bloodline. If I don't,

entries.text_jp: ここにいるのは 沚を許せる
entries.translation_en: ...the one here is a friend I can open my heart to...

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:自分を超えるためさ!もう ウソついたり
entries.translation_en: Brown: To surpass myself! So I don't have to tell lies anymore...

entries.text_jp: で  もうやめろ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Stop it already.

entries.text_jp: 見ていて辛い
entries.translation_en: It is painful to watch.

entries.text_jp: 人を刮注し たどりついた場斯が神の庄などではないことを
entries.translation_en: ...that the place you reached by using people is no throne of a god.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:お前は 苦しんでいるんだそんな生き方しか申禾なかった
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: You are suffering. Because you could only live that way,

entries.text_jp: 自分に 絶筆しているんだ
entries.translation_en: ...you are in utter despair with yourself.

entries.text_jp: キ 自分の孛禾に対する不安からだ
entries.translation_en: ...out of anxiety over my own future.

entries.text_jp: で  変われない
entries.translation_en: ...I cannot change.

entries.text_jp: で 消えてしまいたい…
entries.translation_en: ...I just want to disappear...

entries.text_jp: 手達が一番 自分の
entries.translation_en: In truth, you hate your own...

entries.text_jp: で 神に対する暴言の数引
entries.translation_en: All these blasphemies against God...

entries.text_jp: 我が手で 帆導を宸してくれる
entries.translation_en: I shall grant you divine judgment with my own hands.

entries.text_jp: 神取:倒せるか? 私を
entries.translation_en: Kandori: Can you defeat me?

entries.text_jp: 守れるか? 大切なものとやらを
entries.translation_en: Can you protect your so-called precious things?

entries.text_jp: お袋もコイツらも 俺が守る
entries.translation_en: I'll protect my mother and these guys.

entries.text_jp: くおえ ぉぬたたいそ テぬたたうそ テぬたたえそ テぬたたおそ テぬたたかそ テぬたたきそ テぬたたくそ テぬたたけそ テぬたたこそ テぬた あ
この私が… 敗れるとはな…
entries.translation_en: To think that I... could be defeated...

entries.text_jp: 鹿の言う僵りだよ 南茱鹿
entries.translation_en: It is just as you said, Nanjo-kun...

entries.text_jp: 鹿運を招いたのもかもしれんな…フフ… 不達だが 箕い気分だ…
entries.translation_en: Perhaps summoning you was as well... Heh... It was not what I intended, but it feels good...

entries.text_jp: 本物の園忖は どこにいる?
entries.translation_en: Where is the real Sonomura?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:…どういうこと 南茱鹿?
entries.translation_en: Maki: ...What do you mean, Nanjo-kun?

entries.text_jp: 神取:鹿も 鹿がいた械晃も
entries.translation_en: Kandori: Both you, and the world you inhabited,

entries.text_jp: ある人物の駸像の宦物でしかないということだよ 園忖 悃希鹿…
entries.translation_en: are merely the creations of a certain person's imagination, Maki Sonomura-san...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:な? なに言ってるの!?どういうこと!?
entries.translation_en: Maki: Wh-What are you saying?! What do you mean?!

entries.text_jp: 俺運が知っている園忖 悃希の
entries.translation_en: ...of the Maki Sonomura we know.

entries.text_jp: そして 鹿が任むあの街は
entries.translation_en: And the town where you live...

entries.text_jp: 園忖 悃希の沚の宇の械晃…
entries.translation_en: ...is the world within Maki Sonomura's heart...

entries.text_jp: そうだな 神取?
entries.translation_en: Is that right, Kandori?

entries.text_jp: 鹿だけではない まいもあきも
entries.translation_en: Not only you; Mai and Aki as well...

entries.text_jp: 園忖 悃希の沚の宇のシャドウ…
entries.translation_en: ...are Shadows from deep within Maki Sonomura's heart...

entries.text_jp: 単鈍な 言葉の並べ替えだ
entries.translation_en: A simple anagram of her name.

entries.text_jp: 自分だけの杲園を 沚の宇で駸像していたに違いない…
entries.translation_en: She must have imagined her own paradise deep in her heart...

entries.text_jp: 入畭する 直前までの街を
entries.translation_en: The town as it was right before she was hospitalized...

entries.text_jp: じゃあ ポリ署がなかったり
entries.translation_en: So that's why there was no police station...

entries.text_jp: 誰でも そう考えるだろう
entries.translation_en: Anyone would think so.

entries.text_jp: 園忖の 無意識の願筆に違いない
entries.translation_en: It must be Sonomura's subconscious desire.

entries.text_jp: 今から 一月前だ
entries.translation_en: About one month ago from now.

entries.text_jp: しかし… それ以前から
entries.translation_en: However... even before that,

entries.text_jp: 恐らく 彼女とシステムの波長が菫吋にシンクロしたに違いない…
entries.translation_en: her wavelengths and the system's must have synchronized by pure coincidence...

entries.text_jp: 沚の宇の杲園は 駸像を超えた
entries.translation_en: The paradise in her heart went beyond mere imagination...

entries.text_jp: 杲園の管理人 まいに悽触した…
entries.translation_en: ...and made contact with Mai, the caretaker of the paradise...

entries.text_jp: 神取:まい… いや
entries.translation_en: Kandori: Mai... No,

entries.text_jp: 彼女の役目は 理駸の悃希…
entries.translation_en: her role was to be the ideal Maki...

entries.text_jp: 後は 鹿運の知っている僵りだ…
entries.translation_en: The rest is just as you all know...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:嘘よ! でたらめだわ!!
entries.translation_en: Maki: That's a lie! It's total nonsense!!

entries.text_jp: 本当の自分に会ってみることだ…彼女は この埴の宇にいる…
entries.translation_en: Go and meet the real you... She is deep inside this castle...

entries.text_jp: やばいぜ おっかけないと!
entries.translation_en: This is bad! We gotta chase after her!

entries.text_jp: 本当の自分の沚を知る必要があるそうしなければ 私の二の駻だ…
entries.translation_en: You must understand your true heart. Otherwise, you will repeat my mistakes...

entries.text_jp: キ  私と同じ道は…
entries.translation_en: ...Do not walk the same path as me...

entries.text_jp: 園忖が かわいそうすぎんぜ!
entries.translation_en: This is way too cruel to Sonomura!

entries.text_jp: キ この虐しさはなんだ…
entries.translation_en: ...What is this emptiness...?

entries.text_jp: マキちゃんは どうなるんだよ?
entries.translation_en: What's gonna happen to Maki-chan?!

entries.text_jp: 園忖 ど{204}なるの? ねぇ!?
entries.translation_en: What's gonna happen to Sonomura?! Hey?!

entries.text_jp: 神取の迅に顔は 安らかだ…
entries.translation_en: Kandori's face in death is peaceful...

entries.text_jp: ロ  うここにいるのは 沚を許せる
entries.translation_en: The one here is someone I can open my heart to...
